So, it's the whole 30th anniversary thing. Well last week, my wife and I went to see the first movie performed at the Hollywood Bowl with the score played by the LA Philharmonic. It was awesome. It was so good, that it inspired me to rewatch all the movies. I've always liked them all (even the 3rd one), but this time around I caught one of I'm sure many plot holes in the 3rd movie... hear me out.

So at the end of the 2nd movie, Marty and Doc get caught in a rain storm and the Doc gets struck by lightning and sent back to the 1800's deep into the wild west. Right at the end of the movie, there's a Western Union letter that gets sent to Marty, which the Doc states to Marty that he's in fact okay, that he loves the west and that Marty will find a buried Delorean in a cave to get back home. So, Marty does the logical thing and finds the current instance of Doc Brown to get help.

Okay. So far so good. Marty finds the old Doc - but in their discussions finding the Delorean that was buried for them, they find out that the 1800's Doc actually gets murdered. They both decide that Marty better go back and save the Doc! It's the only reasonable thing to do. So, they dress Marty up in a silly wild west costume and BLAMO he gets sent back to the past.

As soon as he arrives - he gets chased by a bunch of Native Americans who end up shooting an arrow into the Delorean he traveled in causing him to rupture his fuel tank and lose his fuel. Holy cow, we have a problem. Marty finally finds the Doc and they have to hook up the Delorean to the train and push it to 88 miles per hour, but people fall in love, they take a picutre... it's a whole thing, but they make it.

OK. Here's the plot hole. There are 2 Deloreans in the same time period at the same time. There is the one that Doc buries for Marty, and the one Marty travels back in. There is literally another Delorean just hanging out in a cave somewhere, just ready to be used. They didn't have to mess with any trains or duel Biff Tannen. Why, oh why, don't they just find the other Delorean and make like a tree and get out of there?!?
Can we talk about Back To The Future (3)?

Or just drain the gas tank from the one that was already buried, unless Doc drained all the fluids in prepping it for burial.

I always thought that they should have just modified the letter that went forward in time to include a note that they needed an extra gas can before Marty goes back to the old west.

Overall yes, they could have avoided all that conflict, but that would make a pretty boring movie. :)
